title: Learning to Fly
subtitle: Toward Photorealistic Vision-Based UAV Control and Hardware Validation
overview: This project extends our existing reinforcement-learning-based UAV visual-servoing research toward more realistic perception and physical deployment. The objective is to bridge the gap between controlled simulation environments and real-world visual feedback by introducing photorealistic rendering, more realistic observation conditions, and hardware validation.
current_progress: The initial visual-servoing framework has been developed and evaluated in simulation. Ongoing work focuses on increasing the photorealism of the simulation environment and preparing for subsequent hardware experiments. Real-world validation is planned and has not yet been completed.

sections.heading: Next Steps
sections.content: Develop a more photorealistic visual simulation pipeline, evaluate the learned controller under realistic observation conditions, and subsequently conduct physical UAV experiments.
